questions.q_en: Which of the following Indian states shares the longest land border with Bangladesh?
questions.solution_en:
• West Bengal shares the longest land border with Bangladesh among the given options. The total length of the India-Bangladesh border is 4,096.7 km, with a significant portion falling in West Bengal.

• Assam shares a border with Bangladesh but has a shorter length than West Bengal.

• Tripura shares a border with Bangladesh but is smaller compared to West Bengal.

• Meghalaya shares a border with Bangladesh, but it too is shorter than West Bengal.

Further Insight:

• India played a key role in Bangladesh's independence in 1971.

• Bangladesh

○ Capital : Dhaka

○ Border length with India: 4,096.7 km

○ Indian states border with India: West Bengal, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Tripura,Assam
